results.title: Self-RAG: Learning to Retrieve, Generate, and Critique through Self-Reflection
results.author: Akari Asai
results.summary: Introduces Self-RAG, which trains a language model to retrieve on demand and to critique its own generations with reflection tokens.

results.title: Corrective Retrieval Augmented Generation
results.author: Shi-Qi Yan
results.summary: Proposes CRAG, which scores retrieved documents and falls back to web search when retrieval is judged unreliable.
